name: Gmail
description: Gmail read-only connector for reading emails and searching messages (FR-GM-01).

email_read.name: Read Email Messages
email_read.description: List, search, and view email messages and metadata in Gmail.

tools.name: gmail_search_emails
tools.label: Search Gmail Messages
tools.description: Search for emails in Gmail using a query string (subject, sender, keywords). Returns matching message summaries.

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 5).

tools.name: gmail_get_email_details
tools.label: Get Email Details
tools.description: Fetch headers, subject, sender, date, and body snippet of a specific Gmail message by message_id.

message_id.description: Hexadecimal ID of the message to retrieve.
